name: cache-keeper
description: A band above the prompt with context size, usage limits, API-equivalent cost and a prompt-cache countdown, plus buttons for session handoffs

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is kept after your last message. Claude Code cannot report this, so set it to what your setup uses: 5 for the standard cache, 60 for the one-hour cache.

warnMinutes.title: Warn when this many minutes are left
warnMinutes.description: Show a notification when the cache timer gets this low.

handoffPrompt.title: Handoff prompt
handoffPrompt.default: Write a handoff for the next session. Add a new section at the top of reports/handoff.md in the same style as the existing sections: what changed in this session and why, where things stand now, and what to iterate on next. Change nothing else.

continuePrompt.title: Continue prompt
continuePrompt.description: What the Clear + continue button sends into the fresh conversation, right after /clear.
continuePrompt.default: Read the newest (top) section of reports/handoff.md and continue from its next steps. Ask me before starting anything large.
